name: zhihu-open-api
description: OctoBus package for the Zhihu Open Platform — in-site and global search, hot list, question recommendations, knowledge base (RAG), and user data APIs.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/CheckConne.name: check-connectivity
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/CheckConne.description: Verify Zhihu Access Secret credentials without exposing the token.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetQuota.name: get-quota
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetQuota.description: Read the daily free quota remaining for each Zhihu capability.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ZhihuSearc.name: zhihu-search
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ZhihuSearc.description: Search within Zhihu for questions, answers, and articles.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GlobalSear.name: global-search
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GlobalSear.description: Search the whole web with optional host and publish-time filters.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetHotList.name: get-hot-list
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetHotList.description: Read the current Zhihu hot list of questions and articles.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetQuestio.name: get-question-recommendations
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetQuestio.description: Recommend Zhihu questions by the caller's profile or a topic.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ListKnowle.name: list-knowledge-bases
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ListKnowle.description: List knowledge bases created or subscribed by the current user.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ListKnowle.name: list-knowledge-base-items
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/ListKnowle.description: Page through the contents of a knowledge base.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/UploadKnow.name: upload-knowledge-file
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/UploadKnow.description: Upload a file and mount it into a knowledge base after parsing.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/SearchKnow.name: search-knowledge
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/SearchKnow.description: Retrieve relevant document snippets from a knowledge base with RAG.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserCon.name: get-user-contents
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserCon.description: List the current or an authorized user's created content.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserFol.name: get-user-followees
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserFol.description: List who the current or an authorized user follows.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserCol.name: get-user-collections
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserCol.description: List the current or an authorized user's recent collections.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserFav.name: get-user-favlists
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetUserFav.description: List the current or an authorized user's public favorites lists.

Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetFavlist.name: get-favlist-contents
Zhihu_Open_Api.Zhihu_Open_Api/GetFavlist.description: List public contents inside a favorites list.
